steps.label: clear the area, lay a barrier floor, barriers to stand on at the two viewpoints
a 3x3 lava pool four blocks under the well, walled in stone, stone under it
mining well with a pump on top and a tank beside the pump; chest for the well's drops; engine placed but not yet powered
a lone pump on stone for comparison (no host, nothing to pump)
lava still under the well before power (expect: Test passed)

steps.name: docked-draining
steps.look: pump on the mining well (right): its STATUS LED (the left LED of the pair high on each face; the right one is the power LED) is BRIGHT BLUE: it has lava queued but no power yet. The lone pump on stone (left) shows the old colours: status LED OFF (dark).

steps.label: wait for the pool to be drained
lava gone from the well's column (expect: Test passed)
the well dug past the pool: a tube now stands in the old lava cell (expect: Test passed)
the tank beside the pump holds the lava

steps.name: docked-idle
steps.look: same view after the drain: the docked pump's status LED is DIM BLUE (connected, nothing to drain) while the well digs on (its tube visible going down if in view); the tank beside the pump shows lava. Lone pump still dark.

steps.name: docked-close
steps.look: close-up of the docked pump's south face: power LED (red-to-yellow) and the dim blue status LED side by side, no tube drawn from the pump itself through the well
